claims.claim: R2-1: enterRace now calls game.startRace(...) first and playScreenChange(root,'chequer') second, with a doc comment explaining why; RETRY, NEXT RACE and RACE all go through enterRace while direct startRace calls get no overlay.
claims.evidence: src/game.ts enterRace (diff lines 29-32) calls startRace and then playScreenChange, under a comment saying the band plays after the synchronous start. onRaceAgain, onNextRace and the start screen's onRace all call enterRace. restart (pause RESTART) and game.startRace add no overlay, and screen-change.test.ts checks this.

claims.claim: R2-1: New test tests/game/chequer-after-slow-start.test.ts mocks createRaceScene to advance fake timers by 300 ms, clicks RACE, advances 250 ms and expects the chequer element still present.
claims.evidence: diff lines 829-875 match this description exactly.

claims.claim: R2-2: The track radiogroup keydown handler now starts with `if (e.altKey || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) return;`, and a new test checks that modified arrows are neither prevented nor change the track, while a plain ArrowRight still selects the next card and is prevented.
claims.evidence: src/ui/start-screen.ts line 417 of the diff has the guard. tests/ui/track-select-modifier-keys.test.ts (diff lines 1378-1418) asserts defaultPrevented false and selected 'a' for each modifier, then for a plain ArrowRight asserts prevented true and selected 'b'.

claims.claim: R2-3: The screen-change--stripes stage now passes bestLaps: memoryBestLaps() to createStartScreen, and tests/ui/screen-change-stage-bests.test.ts checks that the render does not change with stored bests.
claims.evidence: src/ui/stages/screen-change.stage.ts line 303 of the diff passes `bestLaps: memoryBestLaps()`. The test (diff lines 1212-1245) compares the text with and without racer.bestLap set.

claims.claim: R3-1: The duplicated .ui-start__label block was removed from title.css and the selector was added to the existing title-type rule in screens.css (`.ui-pause__title, .ui-start__label`).
claims.evidence: screens.css hunk (diff lines 281-283) adds `.ui-start__label` to the `.ui-pause__title` rule. title.css has no base .ui-start__label rule, only the `.is-desktop` override. start-screen.ts imports './screens.css'.

claims.claim: R4-1: The track card has a pressed state (`.ui-track-card:active` with translate var(--ui-sink-button), box-shadow var(--ui-shadow-pressed), var(--duration-press)). The old focus/hover rule was split: :focus-visible keeps the lift, and the hover lift sits in @media (hover: hover) as :hover:not(:active). The comment was updated.
claims.evidence: title.css diff lines 596-636 show the updated comment, the separate :focus-visible lift, `@media (hover: hover) { .ui-track-card:hover:not(:active) {...} }` and the :active rule using those variables.

claims.claim: R4-1: Every value is an existing token or variable, with no literals.
claims.evidence: The new rules use only var(...) references, so there are no literals. But --ui-sink-button and --ui-shadow-pressed are not defined in the diff, so whether they already exist (presumably in components.css) can't be checked from the inputs.

claims.claim: R4-1: New test tests/ui/track-card-press.test.ts presses the card at 1440×900 and expects a positive translate and a smaller shadow, and at 844×390 with touch it taps and expects the card to return to rest.
claims.evidence: diff lines 1293-1376 match this description, including the [hover:true, active:false] check after the tap.

claims.claim: R4-2: createStartScreen calls watchDesktop and toggles is-desktop. New .ui-start.is-desktop rules apply desktop display/title/button/label type sizes, --desktop-outline on cards, plates, RACE and the brand divider, --desktop-margin padding on both panels, and --desktop-scale on card width, gaps, plate padding, stripes, title car, and RACE's height, padding and icon.
claims.evidence: start-screen.ts line 443 of the diff calls watchDesktop(...classList.toggle('is-desktop')). title.css lines 689-739 have rules for every item listed: brand border-right-width, title, stripes, title car, select padding, label, cards gap, card flex-basis and border, plate padding and border-top, name, best, race min-height, padding, border, font, and the icon.

claims.claim: R4-2: tests/ui/desktop-start-screen.test.ts checks that the phone keeps 56/32/32/22px type and 3px outlines, and that desktop gets 96/48/48/28px type, 4px outlines, cards more than 1.4× wider and 32px margins.
claims.evidence: diff lines 1187-1210 assert exactly these values. The phone outline check is on RACE only (raceOutline 3px).

claims.claim: Test counts / gate results reported per fix (e.g. 109 files, 733 tests ... 113 files, 738 tests; typecheck clean; tests failed before each fix).
claims.evidence: The diff shows only the final state. The pass/fail history and the counts can't be checked from diff.patch. gates.md would cover the final run only.

claims.claim: R2-3 / R4-1 / R4-2: The rendered phone screenshots and baselines are unchanged by the fixes.
claims.evidence: The before/after screenshots are not in the diff. The CSS changes are scoped to :active, @media (hover:hover) and .is-desktop, which fits the claim that the phone menu screenshot is unchanged.

Some claims can't be checked from diff.patch: the per-fix test counts, the fail-before/pass-after history, whether --ui-sink-button and --ui-shadow-pressed already exist, and whether the screenshots stayed the same.
